name: Compose Directed Campaign Formats
description: Compose one accepted hero into deterministic 1080×1350 and 1080×1920 PNG and self-contained SVG formats, then export a portable versioned campaign record.

data.comment:
# Compose Directed Campaign Formats

Build 4:5 and 9:16 artboards from the same complete accepted hero. Both PNGs and self-contained SVGs share the exact text element tree. The final step waits for every artifact, preserves the original record when adding a revision, and exports directed-campaign.json.
